homepage.description.message: figfig is a CLI tool that adds completion popups and history suggestions to zsh on macOS. Find installation instructions, commands, configuration, and development guides.

homepage.introduction.message: figfig completes commands and paths as you type. Install and configure it from the CLI, then use it in your everyday terminal.

homepage.releaseNote.message: The Homebrew tap is being prepared. You can install from source today.

homepage.usage.description.message: Select and insert completions, and accept history suggestions.

homepage.configuration.description.message: Set popup visibility, history suggestions, and candidate limits.

homepage.troubleshooting.description.message: Check helper startup, permissions, and shell integration.
